verdict.rationale: Omnara documents that self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres. Agents are defined as YAML configs, and the product is Apache 2.0 open source with a REST API. Together these give a self-hosted user real data access and a way to leave, but there is no documented export feature, and nothing covers getting data out of the hosted service. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data (conversations, configs, attachments) in open formats, an export path for hosted/cloud users, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete data exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres for analytics, evals, prompt analysis, and training datasets.
An agent starts as a small YAML config
